name: EPIC 247590565
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 11.4 solar radii and 0.94 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,181 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 0.94 solar masses and 11.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,643 K at its surface.
